description: This file defines the 'DateTime' class within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation namespace, providing deprecated static methods related to date and time calculations. These methods mostly delegate to helper classes within the same namespace, and some constants are included for week and day calculations. The class is marked as deprecated, suggesting a transition to more specific helper classes.

classes.name: DateTime
classes.description: A deprecated class providing static methods for date and time calculations, mainly delegating to helper classes.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year, delegating to Helpers::isLeapYear.

methods.name: getDateValue
methods.description: Returns the date serial value for a given date, delegating to Helpers::getDateValue, with exception handling.

methods.name: DATETIMENOW
methods.description: Returns the current date and time, delegating to Current::now.

methods.name: DATENOW
methods.description: Returns the current date, delegating to Current::today.

methods.name: DATE
methods.description: Returns a date value based on year, month, and day, delegating to Date::fromYMD.

methods.name: TIME
methods.description: Returns a time value based on hour, minute, second, delegating to Time::fromHMS.

methods.name: DATEVALUE
methods.description: Converts a date string to an Excel or PHP date/time serial value, delegating to DateValue::fromString.

methods.name: TIMEVALUE
methods.description: Converts a time string to a date/time serial value, delegating to TimeValue::fromString.

methods.name: DATEDIF
methods.description: Calculates the interval between two dates with specified units, delegating to Difference::interval.

methods.name: DAYS
methods.description: Returns the number of days between two dates, delegating to Days::between.

methods.name: DAYS360
methods.description: Calculates days between dates based on a 360-day year, delegating to Days360::between.

methods.name: YEARFRAC
methods.description: Calculates the fractional year difference between two dates, delegating to YearFrac::fraction.

methods.name: NETWORKDAYS
methods.description: Returns the number of working days between two dates, delegating to NetworkDays::count.

methods.name: WORKDAY
methods.description: Returns a date shifted by a number of working days, delegating to WorkDay::date.

methods.name: DAYOFMONTH
methods.description: Returns the day of the month from a date, delegating to DateParts::day.

methods.name: WEEKDAY
methods.description: Returns the day of the week for a date, delegating to Week::day.

methods.name: WEEKNUM
methods.description: Returns the week number for a date according to specified method, delegating to Week::number.

methods.name: ISOWEEKNUM
methods.description: Returns the ISO week number for a date, delegating to Week::isoWeekNumber.

methods.name: MONTHOFYEAR
methods.description: Returns the month of a date, delegating to DateParts::month.

methods.name: YEAR
methods.description: Returns the year of a date, delegating to DateParts::year.

methods.name: HOUROFDAY
methods.description: Returns the hour component of a time, delegating to TimeParts::hour.

methods.name: MINUTE
methods.description: Returns the minute component of a time, delegating to TimeParts::minute.

methods.name: SECOND
methods.description: Returns the second component of a time, delegating to TimeParts::second.

methods.name: EDATE
methods.description: Returns a date offset by a number of months, delegating to Month::adjust.

methods.name: EOMONTH
methods.description: Returns the last day of a month offset, delegating to Month::lastDay.
